fr.elements: Main Residence; Pool Area; Access Drive; Front Driveway; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can travel its full length without obstruction.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris so emergency vehicles can reach the main residence and detached structure without delay.
• Mark the driveway entrance width visibly so responders know whether large vehicles can enter before committing to the drive.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides of the access drive to give responders clear sightlines to both structures as they approach.
• Post a property layout diagram near the driveway entrance showing the location of the main residence, detached structure, and pool area so arriving responders can orient quickly.
• Create a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings on foot without pushing through vegetation.
• Keep a gate or opening in any fencing around the pool area accessible and unlockable from the outside so responders can reach or work around the pool without delay.
• Mark the pool area visibly from the access drive so responders are aware of its location during night or low-visibility operations.
• Thin dense vegetation at the rear of the property to give responders at least one usable path to the back of the main residence.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Grass Cover; Vegetation Near Structure; Mixed Vegetation; Long Driveway; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Vegetation Along Driveway
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and grass that are growing directly against the exterior walls of the structure.
• Thin the tree cluster near the structure to open up space between the trees and the building.
• Remove or cut back mixed vegetation growing close to the structure on all sides.
• Clear grass and low shrubs from the ground beneath scattered trees near the structure.
• Cut grass around the structure short and keep it mowed regularly.
• Trim overhanging branches from scattered trees along the driveway to keep the travel lane open.
• Clear shrubs and tall grass growing along the edges of the driveway for its full length.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from shrubs and grass patches near the structure.
• Separate shrub groupings near the structure so there are clear gaps between them and the building.
• Keep the driveway surface and shoulders clear of fallen branches and debris to allow vehicle access.
• Thin shrubs growing along the driveway so they do not narrow or block the travel lane.
• Cut back vegetation on both sides of the driveway entrance to maintain clear sightlines for incoming vehicles.
